results.question: In this wider body crop, which phase is most consistent with the free shoe lifting behind the supporting leg? Distinguish the camera and rearward motion from the later travelling sequence.
results.reference_answer: S7 is most consistent with the wider rear-foot lift. The anchor clearly shows a free shoe raised behind the supporting leg, whose shoe is at the floor. A return is not proved by this frame; lateral travel belongs to a separate sequence and must be observed.

observation.summary: The latest view shows one tan shoe raised behind the supporting leg, with the other shoe visibly at the wooden floor. The wider crop includes black cropped trousers, part of the torso, a lavender wall and a wall barre; the head remains out of view.
observation.guidance: Follow the raised shoe toward the floor within this uninterrupted shot before recording a return. Keep shoe-floor contact distinct from shadows or blur, and do not infer balance or tap quality from this crop.
observation.principle: Use directly visible shoe position and contact within a single shot; this reduces unsupported movement judgments without establishing technique safety.
